# Luxarea Homes

> Luxarea Homes Pvt Ltd is a real-estate advisory based in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, with 25 years in business. It represents buyers of luxury homes in Mumbai, land in and around Mumbai and Alibaug, and property in Dubai. Nothing is sold online: the website exists to start a conversation with a senior advisor.

## Contact
- Office: Parinee Crescenzo, 1B, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai 400051, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 77189 61447
- Email: homes@luxarea.in
- Website: https://www.luxarea.in/

## Services
- Luxury homes in Mumbai: sea-facing apartments, penthouses and bungalows in South Mumbai, Worli, Bandra and Juhu; new and resale; listed and off-market. Includes a private shortlist, viewings in person or by video, title and approvals checks, and negotiation through to registration.
- Land in Mumbai and Alibaug: plots in and around Mumbai and in Alibaug, Kihim and Mandwa. Includes checks of NA (non-agricultural) status, the 7/12 extract, a title search, DP remarks, CRZ and FSI/TDR potential.
- Property in Dubai: apartments and villas in Downtown, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Hills and Dubai Marina, ready and off-plan. Includes developer track-record and escrow checks, Golden Visa eligibility, LRS remittance planning and DLD registration.

## How it works
1. A 20-minute brief by phone or at the BKC office.
2. A private shortlist, including off-market homes.
3. Viewings in person or by live video walkthrough.
4. Due diligence on title, approvals, society and dues, with the buyer's lawyer.
5. Negotiation, then agreement, stamp duty, registration and handover.

## Discretion
Buyers' names and numbers are not shared with developers or other brokers. Off-market homes are shown by invitation, under NDA on request. One senior advisor handles each search.

## Frequently asked questions
- Can NRIs and OCI card holders buy property in India? Yes, residential and commercial property, without RBI approval. Not agricultural land, plantation property or farmhouses. Payment from abroad through banking channels or from NRE, NRO or FCNR accounts.
- How much can a resident Indian remit to buy property in Dubai? Up to USD 250,000 per person per financial year under the RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme; family members can pool their limits. TCS applies above ₹10 lakh a year and can be claimed against income tax.
- Does Dubai property qualify for the UAE Golden Visa? Property worth AED 2 million or more can qualify for the 10-year Golden Visa, under the rules in force at the time of application.
- Can I buy agricultural land in Maharashtra? Generally only agriculturists can, so most buyers purchase NA (non-agricultural) plots after verifying the NA order, 7/12 extract, title and CRZ.
